crossRefs.note: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

translations.web: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
translations.bsb: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
translations.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
translations.asv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
